# Short Form Storytelling

## Procedure
Hook immediately; escalate in clear beats; preserve factual nuance; reveal payoff; optional concise call-to-action. Write narration and on-screen caption segments.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
